record.explanation: The source page (PDF page 2, question 4) shows the question as printed. Under the Medicinal and Toilet Preparations (Excise Duties) Act, 1955, toilet preparations containing alcohol or a narcotic drug attract the higher rate of 50% ad valorem. Confidence is medium because this rests on recall of the schedule rate rather than on the page itself.
